afterimagemediaapi-desc: Provides authenticated access to bounded raster thumbnails for AFTERIMAGE synchronization
apihelp-afterimageimage-summary: Returns a bounded raster thumbnail to an authenticated reader
afterimagemediaapi-login-required: You must be logged in to use this image endpoint.
afterimagemediaapi-invalid-title: The supplied title is not a valid file title.
afterimagemediaapi-file-missing: The requested file does not exist.
afterimagemediaapi-unsupported: Only raster images can be returned.
afterimagemediaapi-transform-failed: The image thumbnail could not be generated.
afterimagemediaapi-read-failed: The image thumbnail could not be read.
afterimagemediaapi-too-large: The image thumbnail exceeds the 25 MB limit.
